scope: Hosted D47 acceptance module-load setup repair
confirmed_cause: The hosted workflow installs only playwright-core in a temporary runtime and does not install checkout dependencies. The D47 entry imports a source helper that resolved a bare typescript import from that checkout. Local source guards ran with the full node_modules tree, so they missed the hosted boundary.
repair: For the D47 case, the package phase installs the exact TypeScript 6 alias version recorded for the root importer in pnpm-lock.yaml, verifies the installed name and version, and passes its absolute module path to the driver. The package phase imports the actual D47 entry before the browser phase; an import failure stops setup before Chromium download. Other cases keep their existing runtime.

guard.red: In a copied checkout with no node_modules, the actual D47 entry rejects at import with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND naming typescript.js before any browser work.
guard.green: After installing Playwright and the exact lock-derived TypeScript alias into an isolated temporary runtime, the same entry prints HOSTED_D47_DRIVER_IMPORT_READY and exits 0.
guard.limits: This guard proves module loading and dependency resolution, not native browser behavior.

static_checks: node --check for touched modules, Biome check for five touched code files, git diff --check
other_imports: Bare package imports in neighboring browser scripts belong to separate cases or local source tests; this fix targets the only newly introduced D47 runtime import. No product code changed.
remaining: Fresh source review and separately authorized hosted native run. D47/T57 product acceptance remains unverified.
